decisive_items: A 71-year-old patient with recurrent stage IIIC papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary
BRCA-1 mutation (c. 2563C > T p. Q855*) at 33.3% MAF
response.rationale: The champion candidate, R8, is the most likely diagnosis due to the patient's initial diagnosis and recurrence of ovarian cancer, which is further supported by the presence of a BRCA-1 mutation in the tumor tissue. The runner-up candidate, R7, is also a strong contender, but it is more specific to the genetic mutation rather than the overall diagnosis.

rejected.why: The patient's development of metastases after initial treatment suggests resistance to paclitaxel/carboplatin, but it is not the primary diagnosis.
The patient's metastases are a result of the primary diagnosis, rather than the primary diagnosis itself.
This candidate is an append-only completion of R8 and does not provide any new information.
